cases.note: later shift listed first: processing is by clock-in order
1h shift with a 60 minute break: the daily allowance goes to the next shift
8h day shift, then a night shift: each shift uses its own standard day (8.6 / 7) but they share one hours counter
night shift first, then a day shift on the same date
rest day: 150% from the first hour
two shifts with different day types on one date
no rate and no allowance: net shares are zero
an open shift has no clock-out, so it has zero hours
malformed shift: hours are clamped at zero
cap 0: everything beyond the standard day is 150%
